title: Radiant Nuclear pinned tour
description: A pinned, scroll-told programme tour on cream. A bold all-caps heading and a paragraph stay at the top of the window; below them one illustration at a time sits centred, with a short centred caption under it and a thin progress track at the bottom. Scrolling crossfades the illustrations, lifts each new caption 14px into place as the last one sinks away, steps the dark segment along the track, and glides a small teal pointer across it.
notes: (steps × 0.6 + 1) screens tall: 400svh with five steps; the stage is one window high, at most 1100px
works with 2 to 7 steps; each step's caption is a lead line and a few sentences
pure CSS scroll-driven; without scroll timelines or with reduced motion it becomes a plain list of illustrated steps
